task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock, and if it is, find popular alternatives in the same electronics category, pick the best option for 1 item, place 1 unit on hold, and then confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using the SAVE15 coupon and send it to alice@company.com with PayPal, then check my investment account status, get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate, generate an invoice for the best recommendation as well, check whether NASDAQ is open, place a sell order for 5 shares of AAPL using a USD price of 185.5 converted to EUR, and then send me a high-priority app alert with the execution result.

user_input.query: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk is in stock in the electronics category. The item details are items: [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}], and also product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1. Finally, send me a high-priority app alert with the execution result.
